def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Categories.csv', 
                      encoding='cp1252', header=2)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['Rank'].notna()]
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df['Rank'], errors='coerce').notna()]
    return df

def process(load_categories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_categories.copy()
    
    # Convert # of Reports to numeric (remove commas)
    df[' # of Reports '] = df[' # of Reports '].astype(str).str.replace(',', '')
    df[' # of Reports '] = pd.to_numeric(df[' # of Reports '], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove any rows with NaN values
    df = df.dropna(subset=[' # of Reports '])
    
    # Get max and min
    max_reports = df[' # of Reports '].max()
    min_reports = df[' # of Reports '].min()
    
    # Calculate ratio
    ratio = max_reports / min_reports
    ratio_rounded = round(ratio, 2)
    
    # Return result as DataFrame
    result = pd.DataFrame({
        'Most Frequent': [int(max_reports)],
        'Least Frequent': [int(min_reports)],
        'Ratio': [ratio_rounded]
    })
    
    return result

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate the ratio of reports between the most frequent category (max reports) and the least frequent category (min reports), rounded to 2 decimal places
